A changed CARDProbe result raises a shared change flag; card-condition states include normal state 0, change-detected state 1, error state 2, and paired states 3 and 4 selected according to card validity. Save processing moves from idle state 0 to pending state 1 when the lower-level operation returns 0xB, polls until a terminal status arrives, records failures, and returns to idle. The Memory Card access camera renders only while the pending state is 1, and initialization or teardown resets the operation and asset fields.
src/melee/lb/lbcardgame.c.rationale: The current opening preserves CARDProbe change detection and the card-condition state machine's normal and validity-dependent transitions; the rest of the current unit retains asynchronous save and rendering states.
